title: An oracle on a superposition
objectives: Calculate a coherent oracle output term by term.
Separate oracle evaluation from the information one measurement reveals.
prerequisites: Chapters 3–6: tensor products, unitary gates, joint-state order, coherent control and measurement.

quizzes.question: What does one joint Z shot after the oracle return?
options: All f(x) values and their amplitudes.
One input label and its corresponding target record.
feedback: Those are not all read out in one shot.
Correct: repeat preparation to collect more records.
A simulator display is model access.

quizzes.question: For uniform two-input parity with target zero, what is P(Y=1)?
feedback: Only half the input labels have odd parity.
Correct: inputs 01 and 10 each carry probability 1/4.
The oracle toggles the target for two inputs.
